Rules.InvariantScript: "Click to view the How to Guide"
"We didn't find any data to show at this time"

SortByColumns(
    Filter(
        colApprovalsSource,
        (IsBlank(Dropdown_Crew_App.Selected.Value) || Employee_Name = Dropdown_Crew_App.Selected.Value),
        (IsBlank(DatePickerFrom_Date_App.SelectedDate) || StartDate >= DatePickerFrom_Date_App.SelectedDate),
        (IsBlank(DatePickerTo_Date_App.SelectedDate) || EndDate <= DatePickerTo_Date_App.SelectedDate)
    ),
    "EndDate",
    SortOrder.Descending
)

If(
    ThisItem.ApprovalStatus_1 = "Approved", RGBA(108, 212, 136, 1), // Green
    ThisItem.ApprovalStatus_1 = "Rejected", RGBA(252, 124, 124, 1), // Red
    ThisItem.ApprovalStatus_1 = "Pending", RGBA(252, 250, 124, 1), // Yellow
    RGBA(255, 255, 255, 1) // Transparent
)

If(
    IsBlank(
        LookUp(
            colVacationsUpdates,
            ID = ThisItem.ID
        )
    ),
    Collect(
        colVacationsUpdates,
        {
            ID: ThisItem.ID,
            Employee: ThisItem.Employee,
            ApproverID_1: ThisItem.ApproverID_1,
            TypeofLeave : ThisItem.Type_of_leave, 
            StartDate: ThisItem.StartDate,
            EndDate: ThisItem.EndDate,
            ApprovalStatus_1: Dropdown_Approval1_App.Selected.Value,
            Approver_Comments: TextInput_AppComment_App.Text
        }
    ),
    UpdateIf(
        colVacationsUpdates,
        ID = ThisItem.ID,
        {
            Employee: ThisItem.Employee,
            ApproverID_1: ThisItem.ApproverID_1,
            ApproverID_2: ThisItem.ApproverID_2,
            TypeofLeave : ThisItem.Type_of_leave, 
            StartDate: ThisItem.StartDate,
            EndDate: ThisItem.EndDate,
            ApprovalStatus_1: Dropdown_Approval1_App.Selected.Value,
            Approver_Comments: TextInput_AppComment_App.Text
        }
    )
);
